title: Voice still silent after fix #181 — orphan localStorage 'agf.audio.volume=0' from old bug never gets cleared
summary: User report: 'voice synth still doesn't work after the S153/S154/S155 + fix #181 wave.' Diagnosed. Fix #181 correctly separated the mute toggle from the volume dial (`let muted = masterGain === 0` is gone; mute now reads `agf.audio.muted`). BUT the user who hit the ORIGINAL bug still has `localStorage['agf.audio.volume'] = '0'` from a long-ago mute click. `resolveAudioVolume()` reads that key on every boot, returns 0, and `createKaboomAudioFx({ masterGain: 0.4 * 0 })` initializes with masterGain=0. The audioFx now correctly reports `isMuted()==false` but every `play()` routes through gain envelopes scaled by `masterGain * factor` = 0 — still silent. The fix stopped the future leak but didn't migrate users whose localStorage was already poisoned. Voice + footstep + bomb + blast + pickup + match chime all remain silent until the user manually `localStorage.removeItem('agf.audio.volume')`.
repro: Open `?project=kaboom-crew` in a tab that ever previously had the original mute-toggle bug write — `localStorage['agf.audio.volume']='0'` is still present.
DevTools console: `localStorage.getItem('agf.audio.volume')` → returns '0'. `localStorage.getItem('agf.audio.muted')` → returns null (the new key was never written in the old session).
Boot kaboom-crew → press Space → place a bomb → no audio at all. `__agf.kaboom.testVoice('pickup')` returns true (because `isMuted()` is correctly false now), but no sound plays.
The pause-menu 'Audio: ON/OFF' button toggles `agf.audio.muted` but never touches `agf.audio.volume` — the user has no in-game way to recover.
Workaround that fixes it instantly: `localStorage.removeItem('agf.audio.volume'); location.reload();`.
expected: Fix #181 should restore audio for users affected by the original bug — not just for new users. Cleanest path: in `resolveAudioVolume()`, treat a stored `'0'` as a legacy artifact when no URL `?audio=` param explicitly requested it AND the user hasn't set `agf.audio.muted='1'` — clear it on boot and return the default (1). Equivalent: ignore stored `'0'` entirely; let the new `agf.audio.muted` key be the only source of truth for mute, and the dial defaults to 1 unless `?audio=` overrides.
actual: `resolveAudioVolume()` still returns 0 for stuck users because their localStorage retains the old write. masterGain=0 silences every play(). The pause-menu Audio toggle now writes to `agf.audio.muted` only — it can't unstick the old key. The user has no in-game escape; only DevTools can recover.
